title: A Smooth Locally Exact Penalty Method for Optimization Problems over Generalized Stiefel Manifolds
summary: In this paper, we consider a class of optimization problems constrained to the generalized Stiefel manifold. Such problems are fundamental to a wide range of real-world applications, including generalized canonical correlation analysis, linear discriminant analysis, and electronic structure calculations. Existing works mainly focuses on cases where the generalized orthogonality constraint is induced by a symmetric positive definite matrix M, a setting where the geometry essentially reduces to that of the standard Stiefel manifold.
